schema: kernels.lock v1: pinned NAIF kernels. sha256 and size are verified on every download and every engine load; a mismatch is refused.
provenance: Trust-on-first-use: hashes computed from the first download over HTTPS from naif.jpl.nasa.gov (NAIF publishes no checksums for these files). Retrieval date 2026-10-20. To refresh run `python -m backend.ephemeris.fetch --write-lock` and review the diff.

kernels.role: binary PCK, Moon principal-axes orientation from the DE440 libration

kernels.name: moon_de440_250416.tf
kernels.role: frame kernel defining MOON_PA_DE440 and MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (alias MOON_ME)
